name: Marcos Ros Sempere - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a new strategy for media literacy and digital learning
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for a common EU push to teach people of all ages how to judge what they see online. It wants media literacy taught in schools from an early age, training for teachers, and support for parents, libraries and community groups. It also asks the Commission to look at rules for social media platforms, influencers and AI-made content, and to check how digital devices affect learning and well-being.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act, including possible new rules on age-appropriate platform access.
- **Who it affects:** Children, parents, teachers, older people, influencers, platforms and media.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to follow it up.
